person_note: The 51 numbered chapters constitute the sustained base narration and use third person while shifting among Hollis and other focal characters. A communal first-person-plural voice appears only in the prologue and epilogue; those brief bookends are framing exceptions rather than a co-controlling base strand. Sustained Goodreads scenes and whole-book descriptions support THIRD. Confidence is medium because the authorized excerpt emphasizes the frame and the whole-book structural descriptions are Tier C.
